title: momentum_labels row
description: Logical row for hypertable momentum_labels (see shared/databases/migrations/007_momentum.sql). MOMENTUM_SCANNER_PHASE1.md §6 — the real Phase 1 deliverable and the dataset Phase 2 trains on. Forward outcomes for historical gated candidates. Features for day t use only bars <= t; labels use only bars > t. The hit_200/300/500/1000 flags exist as Phase 2 training targets only — Phase 1 never computes or displays a score for them. SURVIVORSHIP BIAS IS PRESENT: a universe list pulled today omits delisted tickers, which are disproportionately failures; results must not be presented as unbiased.

horizon_days.description: H, forward window in trading days (default 120)

bars_available.description: Forward bars actually present after t; fewer than H implies label_complete = false

label_complete.description: false for rows inside the last H sessions. Incomplete rows MUST be excluded from any evaluation (§6)

entry_close.description: close[t], the gain denominator; copied for reproducibility

fwd_max_drawdown_pct.description: Largest peak-to-trough decline within the window, as a negative percent

hit_100.description: fwd_max_gain_pct >= 100. The Phase 1 evaluation target: score deciles must beat the base rate on this (§6)
